title: Mod Conflict Scanner
subtitle: Checks if multiple mods modify the same files — when they do, only the last mod in your load order takes effect
scanFailedHint: Check that the backend is running, your workshop path is set in Settings, and mods are downloaded.
readyToScanDesc: Cross-checks every active mod's files against the others to find what conflicts — and tells you which mod actually wins.
fileOverlapsDesc: Lua scripts, items, textures, maps, sounds — anything two mods both ship.
loadOrderWinnersDesc: For each clash, identifies which mod actually takes effect at runtime.
missingDepsDesc: Flags mods that require other mods you don't have installed.
readOnlyHint: Read-only — the panel never modifies your mod files. Typically takes a few seconds.
modListChanged: Your mod list changed since this scan — results may be outdated.
scanIncompleteDesc: The result limit was reached. Counts and winners below are partial. Remove unused mods or scan a smaller selection, then rescan.
idCollisionTitle_one: Mod ID collision — {{count}} mod declared by multiple Workshop items
idCollisionTitle_other: Mod ID collision — {{count}} mods declared by multiple Workshop items
idCollisionDesc: PZ will load only one of each. The others are silently ignored — common cause of "my mod isn't working" issues.
missingDepsTooltipLine1: Mods that require other mods not in your server config.
missingDepsTooltipLine2: Click to view details and fix them.
noModsConfigured: No mods are configured. Add mods in Server Config first.
notOnDiskTooltip: Tracked mods not downloaded locally. They can't be analyzed for conflicts — download them via Steam Workshop or remove from WorkshopItems.
identicalTooltip: Files shared by multiple mods with byte-identical content. The result is the same regardless of load order.
additiveTooltipTitle: Files PZ merges automatically. These are not conflicts:
modsScannedNoOverlap_one: {{count}} mod scanned — no files overlap between different mods.
modsScannedNoOverlap_other: {{count}} mods scanned — no files overlap between different mods.
identicalFilesShared_one: {{count}} identical file shared across mods (safe, not a conflict)
identicalFilesShared_other: {{count}} identical files shared across mods (safe, not a conflict)
filesAutoMerged_one: {{count}} file PZ merges automatically (translations, sandbox options, clothing, scripts)
filesAutoMerged_other: {{count}} files PZ merges automatically (translations, sandbox options, clothing, scripts)
severityRealTitle: Critical + Medium pairs most likely to change behavior
severityAllTitle: Every detected overlapping pair, including low-impact file overrides
filterConflictPairsAria: Filter conflict pairs by mod name
groupByWinnerTitle: Collapse pairs under whichever mod wins them. Off = flat list.
thirdModWinsTooltip: Both {{modA}} and {{modB}} ship these files, but a third mod loaded later overrides them both. Reordering this pair won't change the outcome.
decidedTooltip_one: Load order picks a clear winner, but the conflict is real — the losing mod's changes won't take effect. Review the file below to confirm this is the outcome you want.
decidedTooltip_other: Load order picks a clear winner, but the conflict is real — the losing mod's changes won't take effect. Review the files below to confirm this is the outcome you want.
mixedThirdMod_one: {{count}} file taken by a third mod.
mixedThirdMod_other: {{count}} files taken by a third mod.
mixedUndetermined_one: {{count}} file undetermined (mod not in Mods= list).
mixedUndetermined_other: {{count}} files undetermined (mod not in Mods= list).
allDepsSatisfiedDesc: Every mod's required dependencies are present in your server config.
addResolvedPartialTitle: Adds the {{count}} dependencies that have a known Workshop ID. {{remaining}} need a manual Workshop search.
addResolvedAllTitle: Adds all {{count}} resolvable dependencies in one shot.
viewOnSteamWorkshopAria: View on Steam Workshop (opens in new tab)
workshopSearchDisabled: Workshop search is disabled — add a Steam Web API key in <1>Settings → Mods</1> to enable online Workshop search. Without it, only locally downloaded mods can be matched.
noMatchesFoundWorkshop: No matches found on Steam Workshop.
possibleMatchesHint_one: {{count}} possible match — pick the right one and click Add. Steam search is fuzzy, so verify the title before adding.
possibleMatchesHint_other: {{count}} possible matches — pick the right one and click Add. Steam search is fuzzy, so verify the title before adding.
onlyLocalModsSearched: Only locally downloaded mods were searched. Add a Steam Web API key in Settings → Mods to also search the Steam Workshop online.
notHereOpenBrowser: Not here? Open Workshop search in browser
noConflictsRecordedDesc: This mod has no recorded conflicts in the latest scan.
